Description: RQ3 Paired Outcome Matrix between Info-Matched Narrative (Cond C) and CARE Evidence Pack (Cond D)
Cohort: Information-Matched Evaluation Benchmark (N=30 Defect PR Units, ~5,746 vs 5,892 tokens)

Primary_Inferential_Test.Endpoint_Definition: Binary PR-Level Defect Localization (0/1 per PR)
Primary_Inferential_Test.Test_Name: Exact two-sided McNemar's test (binomial distribution on discordant pairs b=6, c=0)

Exploratory_Secondary_Metric.Endpoint_Definition: Continuous Explanation Completeness & Diagnostic Quality Score on [0.0, 1.0] scale
Exploratory_Secondary_Metric.Scoring_Rubric: Partial credit across 4 components: line localization (0.25), root cause explanation (0.25), trigger condition (0.25), remediation validity (0.25)
Exploratory_Secondary_Metric.Decoupling_Note: This continuous secondary metric evaluates diagnostic explanation depth and must not be conflated as a competing test of binary PR localization.
